title: MSF: Over 700 War-Wounded Overwhelm Tigray Hospitals as Fighting Escalates
detail: Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) reports that escalating fighting in northern Ethiopia has overwhelmed hospitals in Tigray. More than 700 war-wounded patients have reached facilities in northwestern and southern Tigray, exceeding hospital capacity. MSF warns that the surge in casualties is straining medical resources and calls for urgent access to provide care to those affected by the intensifying conflict.
